mobile_scope: Chromium device emulation; no physical-device claim
method: tools/check_heart.py with an ephemeral local HTTP server, headless Edge and native CDP touch emulation.

coverage.desktop: Static initial scene, three themes and densities, rate limits, scatter/play/pause, reset retaining settings, canvas-only shortcuts and modifier guards, resize.
coverage.reduced_motion: System preference on load and while playing; static scatter/regroup; disabled playback; leaving reduced motion stays paused.
coverage.lifecycle: Visibility and pagehide/pageshow stop frames; first restored frame retains frozen pixels; manual pause survives; rapid toggles keep one RAF chain.
coverage.inputs: Release-only click, pointer cancellation, blur, hidden, pagehide, movement, long press, canvas exit and resize; fresh click recovers.
coverage.mobile: 390x844 DPR3 and 844x390 Chromium emulation; DPR2 cap; native touch scatter/regroup, cancel, multi-touch, scroll and long press.
coverage.export: Real nonblank 1080x1080 PNG, theme/spread affect image; paused state preserved; asynchronous encoder retains captured pixels while playing; null encoding result allows retry.
coverage.fallback: JavaScript disabled, failed config and unavailable Canvas retain preview and desktop source with controls disabled.
coverage.gallery: 28 cards, home and artwork26 entry, reciprocal fireworks/kaleidoscope links, 390px homepage layout.

python_suite.skip_reason: Optional existing Tk font-boundary desktop check was not enabled.

other_checks.desktop_preservation: 36 drawing snapshots across four aspects, three themes and three scatter states match the published desktop implementation exactly after formula extraction.
other_checks.portable_fixtures: Three Python heart tests cover cardinal coordinates, motion and export stability under positive/negative floating-point perturbations.
other_checks.existing_gallery_smoke: Featured/search, 28 cards, controls, GIF and mobile layout passed without JavaScript errors.
other_checks.independent_review: No actionable findings in model, controller, renderer, desktop extraction or integration.

drawing_bounds.method: Default seed 260, each density through 74 steps of .05 seconds; bounds include particle radii multiplied by 3 for glow.

limitations: Mobile checks emulate Chromium; physical Android and iOS devices were not tested.
Safari and Firefox were not tested.
Browser and desktop share heart and motion formulas, but random generators and rendering differ.
Check-group seconds describe checker runtime, not animation frame rate.
PNG encoders may produce different file bytes for identical pixels; snapshot fidelity is checked after decoding.
